text.2:212: Beautified is the life of the world for those who disbelieve; they make a jest of the believers. But those who keep their duty to Allah will be above them on the Day of Resurrection. Allah giveth without stint to whom He will.
text.6:10: Messengers (of Allah) have been derided before thee, but that whereat they scoffed surrounded such of them as did deride.
text.9:79: Those who point at such of the believers as give the alms willingly and such as can find naught to give but their endeavours, and deride them - Allah (Himself) derideth them. Theirs will be a painful doom.
text.11:38: And he was building the ship, and every time that chieftains of his people passed him, they made mock of him. He said: Though ye make mock of Us, yet We mock at you even as ye mock;
text.21:41: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them.
text.37:12: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
text.49:11: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.
